newsitem.title: USA: Pittston Burlington sees FY EPS $1.90-$2.00.
newsitem.headline: Pittston Burlington sees FY EPS $1.90-$2.00.

text.p: Pittston Burlington, a division of the Pittston Co. said thursday that it expects its full year results to meet current expectations and have savings of $10 to $15 million from cost reducing measures.

Pittston Burlington, the division of Pittston engaged in global freight transportation and logistic management services through its Burlington Air Express Inc, said in a statement that it expects its global innovation team to help the company realize annualized cost savings of a minimum of $5-10 million.
The team was put together, the company said, in order to find efficiencies and upgrade its global information systems for both its customers and its own operations.

The chairman and chief executive of Burlington, Joseph Farrell, said the company's business is expected to improve in the coming months and keep pace with wall street analyst expectations. Farrell said, "We are optimistic about the outlook for Burlington's business for the balance of 1997 and beyond. We expect full year results to be in line with current estimates of $1.90-$2.00 per share exclusive of any special expenses."
